lines: Inside of the giant vortex that had suddenly appeared and wiped out the surrounding landscape, we were standing ready to fight.
I can't see any intruder though...!?
They're always deceiving people with illusions like this!!
Illusions!? For an illusion, it's so...!!
Even while we were talking, we were still being dragged deeper and deeper into the vortexー
Y-You're right, I can still breathe...?! So who's this intruder?!
Yeah. A monster with an octopus head.
It didn't seem like it was Hebiko.
I don't know... It suddenly appeared in the gym in the middle of gym class basketball. That's why I was suspicious because you were also in the gym.
In the gym... wait a second.
Rinko-senpai... can I ask you something?
Weren't you in the gym before you came to this world?
(So maybe the gym is the entrance to this world?)
What do you want to show us this time?!
This heat... is this also an illusion?
This time, a barren landscape with red hot lava flowing through it appeared. It looked the primordial Earth, or like scorched terrain from deep in the Devildom.
The smell of soil is so real... it smells like the Devildom.
I can even sense the miasma...
(Is this really an illusion? If so, then the haunted castle was nothing, and this is someone of considerable skill.)
...Wait, it's possible that this is real...
Oi, who the hell are you guys!?
They showed up out of nowhere!! Where did you come from!?
A horde of Orcs suddenly appeared. And they looked different from the Orcs I had seen before in the black market district.
Hey, Rinko's little brother, are they friends of yours?
Of course they're not!! I've only seen them in books, but I think those are "Rakshasa Orcs."
I've also heard of them. The "Rakshasa Orcs" are a warrior clan that is the strongest among all Orc clans in the Devildom.
They boast power that is on a completely different level from normal Orcs, and they are said to be brutal and ferocious.
Oooh, a woman! There's a woman!!
The Rakshasa Orcs stared at Rinko-senpai while licking their lips.
Interesting, you say... but this means that this isn't an illusion and that we actually got sent to the Devildom!?
Doesn't it seem like it'll be more fun than being at Gosha Academy?
Despite the completely bizarre situation, the two of them seemed to be calm.
(So these are Taimanin who made a name for themselves on the frontlines... you can always count on them.)
Parting the horde of Rakshasa Orcs, a figure with an especially eye-catching iron mask appeared. Presumably their leader?
Hehe, and women, too... what do we do?
The Orc who seemed to be their leader glanced at us.
The Rakshasa Orcs shouted and cheered upon hearing their boss's order, and the next moment a vicious and deadly aura could be felt from the horde.
Hehehe, I'm gonna do this woman.
That's fine, we're gonna end up doing all of them anyway.
How do you want to do this, Rinko-san?
Hmm, let's get warmed up a bit. We're going to have to fight the intruder sooner or later anyways.
The Orcs were discussing how to kill them, but those two didn't seem perturbed in the slightest.
(If Shikanosuke were here, this is where we would hear his "Aieeee!" I bet...)
Anyways, it definitely helped that my friends were this reliable. So I just had to do my part.
Rinko-se... nee-chan, they are well versed in how to attack in large groups. They'll probably try to separate us, so...
So you are saying the three of us have to stick together, right?
Hehe, that makes sense. Got it.
Sakura-sen... Sakura! Use your Shadow Jutsu to distract the enemies who try to flank us!
No point in having a strategy meeting! Because you're all gonna be mincemeat...!
